lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular grid pattern along the posterior-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a checkerboard lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from highlight (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated, high-luminance horizontal feature attached to the mid-lateral flank. A large vertical brown/tan linear foreground element obscuring the posterior distal region.
